{{Quotation|game|The barren desert landscape here is broken only by tall, surprisingly urban-like ruins that mark a people's failed attempt at [[Ascension]]. Made of wood from the ships that brought them to the desert's shores and bricks made of sand and mud, the structures have withstood the harsh desert weather surprisingly well. The people who built them, unfortunately did not...}}

[[Dunes of Despair (outpost)|Dunes of Despair]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is one of the three trials to open the path of [[Ascension]]. It is the home of the [[Temple of Ascension]] and the [[Throne of Pellentia]] that resides within the temple.

==Getting There==
*To get to the Dunes of Despair, head southwest from [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]], via [[Prophet's Path]] and into [[Vulture Drifts]]. From here travel south to the ruins.

==Mission==
*[[Dunes of Despair]]
**This mission is the fifteenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the first mission in the [[Crystal Desert]] region.
